description: This file is a shell script used for testing internationalization (i18n) settings and format-patch operations within Git. It includes setup routines, checks for character encoding preservation across various git commands (like format-patch, rebase, cherry-pick, am), and tests different configurations of commit encoding and output encoding, notably UTF-8 and ISO-8859-1.

methods.name: check_encoding
methods.description: Verifies that the commits and patch outputs preserve the specified character encoding (UTF-8 or ISO-8859-1) across a series of git operations.
